note: Milestone 73F part 1: what each export validator returned before the move to src/core/validation/engines/, over tests/unit/support/filing-variants.js's variants, with the clock at 2026-10-05 noon. Changed by Milestone 73A (2026-10-06, a guardian signs by hand or by stamp): a guardian's blank choice is Unsigned under signature policy 2, so a certificate guardian's date alone (the Annual family, the Simplified) or the Inventory's D-5 guardian's no longer asks for a printed name to apply "/s/" (5 variants); the Annual, Initial and Minors' Plans check each started co-guardian's signature choice (3 variants). New variants clear signaturePolicy (the legacy rule); each returns what its sibling does. Also by 73A: every guardian signature issue (asked again, or an unreadable choice) names the guardian's signature choice as its field -- its path and code -- in place of the date, so its jump link lands on the choice (1,656 variants, no other change). Regenerated by Milestone 73F part 2 (2026-10-06) for its new variants only: a saturated filing's signature choices take Unsigned instead of 'Yes', and each signature block gained a '"/s/" undated' and a 'stamp without image' variant (70 new); the checks are unchanged. Changed by Milestone 74B (2026-10-06, a co-guardian the filer has started is in the filing): a started Plan co-guardian is checked like the first guardian, so on the Annual Plan clearing a co-guardian's name, mailing street, phone or SSN raises "Signatures -- Co-Guardian N ..." (8 variants); on every form "started" is rowStarted(), which no variant's untouched card changes. Changed by Milestone 73F part 3 (2026-10-06): the Initial Inventory requires "Amended Form?" (73F-1) and its blank schedules are a prompt, no longer an export block (73F-4) -- 168 Inventory variants changed: 134 gain "Cover — Amended Form?" and 134 lose the eleven "<schedule> — Add at least one entry..." blocks; the minimal valid Inventory now answers it, so its variant "valid: amendedForm answered" is now "valid: amendedForm cleared". The variant builder answers a blank county with a Florida county and a blank amount with a number (an answer the field can hold, 73F-2 and 73G), so three Annual-family "startingBalance answered" variants (1, not "Yes") reach the reconciliation check. Nothing else moved; no variant gained a county issue.
